title: Pro, Tech and Dynamic Packs
summary: Comments focus on optional packs and extras, with positive remarks about added convenience and sporty appearance but many fragments that only mention pack choices or features without a clear evaluation.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the pro, tech and comfort packs for adding convenience, useful features and a sportier exterior look.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention choosing or paying for packs, pack-linked features and dynamic feel without stating whether this is good or bad.

limitations: Several fragments are too brief to determine sentiment clearly.
The cluster includes both optional equipment packs and a separate mention of the car feeling dynamic, so the topic is not fully coherent.
Samples are stratified and not representative of the full review population.
